parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is a small lever or handle made of stainless steel, attached to the faucet body for controlling water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by moving the lever in different directions.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around a pivot point to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main vertical and base structure of the faucet, made of stainless steel, providing support and housing for internal water channels.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the faucet to the sink and supports the spout and switch, ensuring stability and water flow routing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved upper part of the faucet made of stainless steel, through which water exits.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the faucet to the sink, often designed to swivel for flexible use.
parts.Movement_description: It may rotate horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
